summary: CMS snapshot/restore safety-net and Off-site sales feature both pass end-to-end. Backend pytest: 59/60 pass (only pre-existing out-of-scope Google Sheets test fails — carried over from iter 10). 11 NEW iter-11 tests added and all pass: reset_without_confirm_returns_400, publish_creates_history_snapshot (reason=publish, actor=reachbiraajo@gmail.com), history_get_single_returns_full_payload (includes draft+published), history_get_unknown_returns_404, restore_roundtrip_brings_back_previous_content (baseline → mutate+publish → restore → /api/site-content matches baseline; pre_restore snapshot appears in history), and 6 offsite-bookings tests (create increments seats_booked, list, delete decrements, overbook→400, unauth→401, unknown event→404). Frontend Playwright: admin login OK; /admin/edit shows edit-history button → opens history-modal listing 13 snapshots with restore buttons (modal text contains 'publish' and 'reachbiraajo'), history-close dismisses. /admin admin-tab-offsite renders OffsiteSales with all required testids (offsite-form, offsite-event, offsite-name, offsite-guests, offsite-pref, offsite-source, offsite-submit). End-to-end: submitting offsite booking for a Barsaat event incremented seats_booked from 6 → 7, the offsite-event-block-{id} row showed 'TEST UI Offsite', and the public /supper-club/barsaat page immediately reflected '5 OF 12 LEFT' on the same date card. Cleanup deleted booking; seats decremented 7 → 6.

minor.issue: Pre-existing (iter 9/10 carry-over): when GOOGLE_SHEETS_WEBHOOK_URL is empty the body has webhook_url:'' (empty string), and test_sheets_test_authorized_surfaces_failure asserts truthy. Out-of-scope this iteration.

issues: React hydration warning: a <span> from the Emergent dev-mode dynamic-source wrapper (data-ve-dynamic, x-excluded='true') is injected inside <option>. The user code only renders {e.title} so this is a tooling-injected wrapper, but it spams the dev console. Cosmetic only; submission and option value work correctly.

action_items: (LOW, carry-over) Decide on POST /api/sheets/test contract — either return non-empty webhook_url or update test assertion to tolerate reason='no_webhook_configured'.

(LOW, cosmetic) The dev-mode dynamic-source wrapper injects a <span> inside <option> for the offsite event select — investigate or suppress the hydration warning, or wrap {e.title} differently so the wrapper doesn't trigger inside <option>.
critical_code_review_comments: Snapshot/restore implementation in server.py is clean: _snapshot_site_content captures both draft + published, auto-prunes to 50 entries, and is called on publish, reset, and pre_restore — round-trip restore test confirms correctness.
Reset endpoint correctly hard-gates on confirm:true (returns 400 with 'Confirmation required' otherwise). This addresses the iter 9 data-loss class of bug at the API layer too.

Off-site bookings correctly increment/decrement event.seats_booked atomically via $inc, and overbook returns 400 — public seat counts on /supper-club/barsaat update immediately as confirmed in browser test.
server.py is now ~1192 lines — still recommend splitting into routes_cms.py + routes_offsite.py + routes_settings.py for maintainability.

success_rate.backend: 59/60 (98.3%) — 11/11 new iter-11 tests pass; only failure is pre-existing out-of-scope Google Sheets test
success_rate.frontend: 100% on all in-scope flows (CMS history modal open/restore-list/close, Offsite tab + form + submit + event block + seat-count update on public page + cleanup decrement)

Key new testids: edit-history, history-modal, history-restore-{id}, history-close, admin-tab-offsite, offsite-sales, offsite-form, offsite-event, offsite-name, offsite-guests, offsite-pref, offsite-source, offsite-submit, offsite-event-block-{event_id}. All 3 Barsaat events (Jul 5/18/26 2026, seats_total=12), barsaat.menu.items length=10 with 4 alt_dish entries, and settings (price_veg=2200, price_nonveg=2800) all still intact.
rca of the issue: N/A — features implemented correctly. Round-trip test specifically verifies the iter-9 data-loss class of bug can no longer happen: any publish/reset/restore action snapshots the prior state, and the admin can restore from any of the most-recent 50 snapshots with one click.
